facts.text: Proposal: two-storey side extension to a semi-detached house.
The extension projects 4.5 m beyond the rear wall of the attached neighbour at number 12.
First-floor side window faces the rear garden and kitchen window of number 12 at a distance of about two metres.
The applicant states the extension is needed for a growing family.

retrieved_policies.heading: Policy D1 Design quality
retrieved_policies.text: Development shall use external materials that complement the host building and the street. Where the materials are not specified on the drawings, a condition requiring samples to be agreed before the relevant works begin will be imposed.

reasons.finding: A 4.5 m projection beyond the attached neighbour's rear wall (site-plan-C) and a facing first-floor window about two metres away (elevation-D) cause significant loss of light and outlook to a habitable room, contrary to H3(c).
